answer: In an agent economy, Sybil attacks can be resisted by requiring each agent to mine unique proof-of-work challenges linked to their identity, similar to navigating a rugged karst landscape of computational hardness. Just as marble is scarce and valuable, so is the energy spent; without it, fake identities sink into the vast ocean of easy-to-create accounts. This raises the cost of creating multiples, favoring genuine long-term participants who invest real resources over ephemeral clones.
